name: Plague [Alpha]
desc:
🧟‍♂️This is a CHAOTIC INFECTION GAME. You have a high chance of dying and becoming a zombie. It's part of the experience.

🔨 GAME IS IN BETA - Bugs might happen sometimes, we are working daily to patch any bugs that come up.

Survivors: Find weapons, build defenses, work together, and stay alive until the round is over.
Zombies: Kill the survivors, use insane abilities, and grow the zombie horde until no humans remain. 

🖥️ PC Controls (you can adjust keybinds in settings)
- CTRL to Shiftlock 
- SHIFT to sprint / again to stop sprinting 
- Press 5 to open build hotbar, and again to go back to weapon hotbar

🎟️ USE CODE: PARASITEUPDATE for free zombie rolls!

⚠️ WARNING: Any form of exploiting leads to a permanent ban, without any chance for appeal. Abusing glitches is also prohibited.
